lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: ClearView Rentals, this is Dana from the service review team. I have return ticket CVR-2086 open. Could you tell me what you need reviewed?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: I’m calling regarding order CV-4817, the twenty-seven-inch display delivered today at 10:18. I’d like both the damaged-unit record and the proposed one-hundred-eighty-dollar hold reviewed.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: The intake note says the display was received and later reported as unstable. What information is missing from that summary?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: The record shows that I selected “received with visible package damage” before the driver left. The outer box had a crushed lower-right corner, and that note appears on the delivery receipt.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: What did you observe after opening it?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: At 10:32, I opened the sealed box with Daniel present. The screen was intact, but the mounting bracket was bent, so the display could not stand safely. I stopped before connecting power.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Do you have photographs of the packaging, seal, serial number and bracket?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Yes. Six time-stamped photographs and the delivery receipt were uploaded at 10:51. I also kept all packaging and have not tried to straighten the bracket.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Thank you. Let me summarize where we are: visible box damage was recorded at delivery, internal damage was photographed shortly afterward and the unit has not been used.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: That is accurate. Responsibility has not been determined, so I do not think the file should describe this as customer-caused damage.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: The current hold is only proposed; it has not been charged. What immediate impact do you need us to consider?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: The issue has affected a client review scheduled for Wednesday morning. I rented this model for a color-accurate presentation, and the damaged stand means I cannot set it up safely.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: We can refer the cause question to claims, but replacement availability is handled separately. Which outcome are you requesting today?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: What I’m asking for is a claims review today, a replacement plan by Tuesday at noon and written confirmation that no damage amount will be charged while responsibility remains under review.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: I can confirm the charge pause. It has been estimated that claims review will take one business day, but I cannot promise the replacement until inventory checks are complete.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: That distinction is fine. Before we move on, please record Tuesday noon as the update deadline, not as a guaranteed delivery time.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Recorded. I will send the evidence to Daria in claims and ask inventory to report the same-model and substitute options.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Please confirm how this will be handled in writing, including the case reference, evidence received, charge status, next owner and update time.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: I’ll send that summary within thirty minutes. It will say the cause is undetermined and that the hold remains paused during review.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Thank you. Is that an accurate record of the escalation: investigate cause, identify a workable replacement path and update me by Tuesday noon without treating the proposed hold as a charge?
